dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.text: WKU Medical Centre, good morning. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'd like to make an appointment. I've got a bad stomachache and I've been sick twice this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you got a fever as well?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I'm not sure — I feel hot and cold at the same time. And I've got a really bad headache.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.text: It sounds like it could be food poisoning or a stomach virus. Can you come in right now?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Yes, I can. I'm in the dormitory — I can be there in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.text: Perfect. Ask for Dr. Nurova at reception. She's the duty doctor today.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Nurova
dialogue.text: Come in, Amir. I've read your form. How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Really bad, doctor. My stomach hurts a lot, I've got nausea, and I feel dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Nurova
dialogue.text: Have you eaten anything unusual in the last 24 hours?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I had a chicken shawarma from the street stall near the gates last night. It tasted a bit strange.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Nurova
dialogue.text: That's likely the cause. You've got food poisoning. You have to drink a lot of fluids and rest.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Do I have to take antibiotics?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Nurova
dialogue.text: No, you don't have to — it's not bacterial. But you must avoid solid food for 24 hours. Only water, herbal tea, and clear soup.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Nurova
dialogue.text: No, you don't have to go to hospital. Stay in the dormitory, rest, and come back tomorrow if you're not improving.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel better already just knowing what it is.
